tasks.task:
# Dispatch T4 — startup integration, emitter, and end-to-end gate (engineer)

Feature snapshot-recovery, revision r30. T1-T3 done. Scope: ONLY the five T4 files. No edits to startup_failure.go, wiring.go, main.go, internal/service/**, or any other file; no external research; no network.

## Files (your only write set)
- cmd/mcp-bridge/serve.go
- cmd/mcp-bridge/snapshot_recovery_test.go (new)
- cmd/mcp-bridge/serve_edge_test.go
- cmd/mcp-bridge/startup_failure_test.go
- internal/storage/recovery_test.go

## Read first
- .scratch/snapshot-recovery/spec.md: T4 objective and AC2-1..AC2-9, R1/R3/R4/R9, D3/D4/D5/D8/D12; serve.go current startup flow; startup_failure.go, wiring.go, main.go as read-only inputs.

## Required work
1. Wire the env gate (D4) and the single storage.RecoverRejected call site after storage.Open; emit records via emitRecoveryRecords (per-Recovery mapping incl orphaned_link; per-RetentionFailure pinned literals and fixed message); cause-preserving storage.ErrSnapshotUnrecoverable -> stateDirectoryFailure mapping with an unexported wrapper helper in serve.go.
2. Ensure continue-startup behavior: absent post-recovery paths stay absent; admission persists snapshot; loop async initial refresh persists prompts; second run no-op.
3. Tests: emitRecoveryRecords unit tests and AC2-1..AC2-7 integration in snapshot_recovery_test.go; AC2-4/AC2-5 lanes in serve_edge_test.go; stateDirectoryFailure exact record pin plus recoveryStateDirectoryFailure chain oracle in startup_failure_test.go; AC2-8 seam oracles in internal/storage/recovery_test.go.
4. AC2-9 (now owned by T4 in canonical state): add harness tests with exact names TestSnapshotRecoveryOrphanedLink, TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualLink, TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualBothMoved, TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualHardlinked, TestSnapshotRecoveryNonMutualDangling in snapshot_recovery_test.go, plus the mutual-class retention assertion and the pinned non-mutual originally-dangling OPEN limitation (assert documented behavior; do not falsely pass).
5. Cross-ticket gate: one suite that runs open -> recover (quarantine/reconcile) -> admission -> publish -> prompt persistence -> restart no-op, plus mutual-pair restart (fresh regular prompts accepted by direct SavePrompts) and both-moved/self-moved no-fire with exactly-once counting.

## Verify (report exact commands+outputs)
1. go build ./...
2. go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge/... -count=1
3. go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge/ -run TestSnapshotRecoveryOrphanedLink|TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualLink|TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualBothMoved|TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualHardlinked|TestSnapshotRecoveryNonMutualDangling -count=1 -v (must list the tests as RUN)
4. go test ./internal/storage/... ./internal/observe/... ./cmd/mcp-bridge/... -count=1
End with INCOMPLETE and the exact blocker if any required behavior needs a non-envelope file edit.
